summary: Aermotor steel tower in Lafayette County, Florida, administered by FDACS; a July 2026 report says it is preparing to leave the community. No build date found.

facts.status_note: Still standing as of July 2026, but a move away from the community is reported; destination and timing are unconfirmed.
facts.agency: Florida Department of Agriculture & Consumer Services

events.note: Registered July 24, 2016 as US 1084, FL 11; nominated by Robert Spear.
Riverbend News, July 7, 2026: the tower is preparing to leave the community. Destination and timing are not in the excerpt.

notes_for_editor: The Riverbend article is paywalled: fetch_text returned 403 and WebFetch returned only the opening. The move's destination, reason, timing and the tower's build year are all unknown. Re-check the full article before publishing any move detail. The NHLR page gives no build year and no access information. The Commons photo (March 2024, CC BY 4.0) is a new find.
